outside-the-courthouse.npc: Welcome to the Seers' Village courthouse. Court is not in session today, so you're not allowed downstairs.

inside-the-courthouse.npc: The Seers' Village courthouse. We give all criminals a fair trial, by a jury of their peers. Or whoever we can round up from the pub.
